mcqs.question: Which of the following countries is located in Asia?
mcqs.explanation: India is a country in the continent of Asia. Brazil is in South America, Egypt is in Africa, and Australia is both a continent and a country in the Australian region, not in Asia.

mcqs.question: A student plans a trip to see the Sahara Desert and the Nile River. Which continent will she be visiting?
mcqs.explanation: Both the Sahara Desert and the Nile River are major geographical features of Africa. The other continents listed do not contain these features.

mcqs.question: Which statement about Europe is correct?

options.A: Europe is a continent consisting of many countries.

mcqs.answer: Europe is a continent consisting of many countries.
mcqs.explanation: Europe is a continent made up of numerous independent nations such as France, Germany, and Italy. It is not a single country, an ocean, or a city.

mcqs.question: Which continent lies to the west of Europe?
mcqs.explanation: When looking at a world map, North America is situated west of Europe across the Atlantic Ocean. Asia is east of Europe, Africa is south‑southwest, and Antarctica is far to the south.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements correctly compares South America with Africa?

options.A: South America is larger in area than Africa.
options.B: South America has a larger population than Africa.
options.C: Africa is larger in area than South America.
options.D: Africa and South America have the same land area.

mcqs.answer: Africa is larger in area than South America.
mcqs.explanation: Africa covers about 30 million square kilometres, whereas South America covers about 18 million square kilometres, making Africa larger in area. Africa also has a larger population, so options A and B are false, and the areas are not equal, so D is false.

mcqs.question: Which statement about Australia is correct?

options.A: It is the only continent that is also a single sovereign country.
options.B: It is the most populous continent.
options.C: It is located entirely in the Northern Hemisphere.
options.D: It shares a land border with South America.

mcqs.answer: It is the only continent that is also a single sovereign country.
mcqs.explanation: Australia is unique because the continent and the nation share the same name and boundaries, making it the only continent that is a single sovereign country. It is not the most populous (Asia is), it lies entirely in the Southern Hemisphere, and it has no land borders with any other continent.

mcqs.question: Which continent is covered almost entirely by ice and has no permanent human population?
mcqs.explanation: Antarctica is the southernmost continent, covered by a massive ice sheet, and it does not have any permanent residents. The other continents have permanent populations and are not ice‑covered to that extent.

mcqs.question: Which continent lies directly south of Europe?
mcqs.explanation: When moving directly south from Europe across the Mediterranean Sea, the next continent encountered is Africa. Asia lies to the east, South America to the west across the Atlantic, and Australia far to the southeast.
